description_en: Who are the Aristasians? Why did they leave the modern world? Where did they go instead? And how come they were the ones to make the world's first 18+ video game? Come learn, in toki pona taso, about this very real subculture and their alledgedly even Realer paracosm. Complete with short translated passages from Aristasian works and forums, and everyone's favorite: jargon~
